newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 2.792 bln reais in Central Bank Bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 2.792 bln reais in Central Bank Bonds.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 2.792 billion reais in 56-day and 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) at its weekly formal bond auction Tuesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank sold 972 million reais in 56-day bonds at an overnight rate of 2.333 percent a month, up from 2.324 percent last week.
The 182-day bonds were sold at 2.229 percent a month, up from 2.214 percent last week.
The financial result of the auction indicated 1.708 billion reais will be added to the banking system as 4.5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
